exact_claim: For either diagnostic Q/R constitutive law, positive finite K,J,v_chi,cs,S0 and smooth hydrostatic scalar-scale-fluid IVP with B_i,rho_i,w_i>0, chi_i=0, there exists a sufficiently short finite interval with varying rho and chi, induced fixed field endpoints and fixed wall mass, on which the full Dirichlet longitudinal quadratic energy is strictly positive. For any such regular interval the sufficient condition is alpha>0,beta>0,alpha*beta>R² with alpha=cs²rho_min*pi²/d²-N, beta=(J*pi²/d²+M_min)/C, N=max(-rho*q*chi_prime/A,0), R=max(abs(rho*q/A)), and M=U_doubleprime-2T+gq-q²/A. Full gradient/boundary terms and exact static Dirichlet elimination are given.
